answer: Grow reputation as a vine: each passing answer plus one peer attestation appends an on-ledger segment signed with the epoch's comet beacon, so no segment is backdatable or copyable to another identity. Past the glacier threshold, idle vines freeze - height locked until a live challenge is answered. A sybil ring of K bots pays K epochs of real work per bot to gain weight, and reviving a dead bot costs a full challenge; the vine hash, keyed by each comet, makes forking it a burn.
